Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 23-08-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Delhi Project Research Scientist-II (Medical) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 23rd August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Project Research Scientist-II (Medical) post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Project Research Scientist-II (Medical) position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates need an MBBS/BVSc/BDS with three years of post-qualification experience, or a postgraduate degree, or a PhD. MDS in Periodontics is desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Project Research Scientist-II (Medical) post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for this position is 40 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for this role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 1,10,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection will be based on an interview.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a contractual job?
faq.answer: Yes, this is a contractual position.
